newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: CM Telecom buys two Hong Kong properties.
newsitem.headline: CM Telecom buys two Hong Kong properties.

text.p: CM Telecom International Limited said on Thursday it has purchased two properties in Hong Kong from Chinabest Pacific Limited for a total of Hong Kong $28.47 million.

The first property, bought for HK$14.48 million, includes four units on the 18th floor and two parking spaces in Chinabest International Centre, in Hong Kong's New Territories, CM Telecom said in a statement.
The second property, bought for HK$13.99 million, comprises four units on the 12th floor and two parking spaces in the same building.
CM Telecom said both properties were bought through subsidiaries and it would finance the purchases from internal resources and bank borrowings.
The company said it planned to use the properties for its operations, including trunked radio services.
